proposed_admission_not_installed.before_model: No new foreign GPU process; fresh cgroup/host memory and /proc rank RSS samples; agree available GPUs
proposed_admission_not_installed.cpu_after_load: At least 32 GiB headroom using cgroup usage minus inactive_file (working-set estimate), plus stable pin/offload peaks; never equate all file cache with guaranteed reclaimable memory
proposed_admission_not_installed.gpu_before_first_denoise: After real buffers/nonblock placement, at least 20 GiB free per GPU as a provisional gate; measure first-block peak before committing long generation
proposed_admission_not_installed.first_denoise: Aim peak total usage <=70 GiB/GPU (10 GiB margin); this is a proposed safety margin, not a proven model requirement or change to existing guard
proposed_admission_not_installed.continuous: Monitor through encoder, pinning, AllGather, every denoise step and VAE decode; stage markers + allocated/reserved + device-used + cgroup counters
